professionalOverview.title: Professional Overview
professionalOverview.author: Viswanath Vasa
paragraphs: Hey! I’m Viswanath (Visu), a Computer Science and Applied Mathematics major at the University of Maryland specializing in Cybersecurity and Networking. Throughout my life, I’ve always had a passion for learning and programming, and this portfolio is my love letter to the field in general. The people I’ve met, the projects I’ve worked on, and the concepts I’ve learned have all led up to where I am today.

As you peruse the portfolio, feel free to contact me with any questions you have about any projects! You can contact me at vvasa@terpmail.umd.edu, or check out my LinkedIn or my Github pages to learn more!

technicalApproach.title: Technical Approach
technicalApproach.author: Viswanath Vasa
paragraphs: Security-first development doesn't mean sacrificing speed or innovation. I implement "Shift Left" security practices, integrating vulnerability analysis and threat modeling from day one. This proactive approach has consistently reduced security incidents by over 90% across projects I've led.

My technical stack emphasizes both performance and protection: React and Next.js for responsive frontends, Node.js and TypeScript for type-safe backends, and automated CI/CD pipelines for reliable deployments. I architect systems that scale efficiently while maintaining strict security standards—proven by SenseGuard's 10+ year battery life and 99.9% uptime metrics.

featured.title: SenseGuard, Inc.
description: Designed and deployed a full-stack security monitoring platform processing 1,000+ telemetry events per day across distributed IoT systems. The platform provides real-time monitoring and analytics for industrial safety and operational efficiency.

Containerized backend services using Docker and deployed to Google Cloud Platform, supporting CI/CD workflows and maintaining 99.9% service availability. Configured and provisioned 200+ IoT sensors and gateways across 50+ sites, validating end-to-end data pipelines and standardizing device onboarding procedures.

experience.title: Researcher & Lead Full-Stack Developer
experience.description: Leading full-stack development for secure election training systems with focus on mobile security and data integrity.
achievements: Engineered a secure full-stack Flutter mobile application with a Firebase backend, implementing authentication, role-based access control, and encrypted client-server communication for 2,000+ users.
Designed an offline-first SQLite data pipeline with asynchronous cloud synchronization, ensuring reliable data integrity, auditability, and fault tolerance for 1,000+ user accounts.
Developed a modular content delivery system supporting dynamic text, images, and video, enabling non-technical teams to deploy 50+ interactive training modules.

achievements: Designed and implemented information architecture and navigation flows across 15+ pages, improving usability and content discoverability for enterprise customers.
Iterated on UI layouts and interaction patterns based on stakeholder feedback, enhancing customer experience and supporting engagement across 100+ active users.
